_comment: IDP accuracy Lane B: replacement-level SHADOW methodology (v1).
Read by src/league_valuation/replacement_shadow.py and the offline report
scripts/idp_accuracy/replacement_report.py, and by nothing else: no route,
flag, contract field, cache, engine or page reads it.
Shadow only. Nothing here changes a served value, anchor, flag or scoring rule.
PROVENANCE OF EVERY NUMBER: each constant is classified CONVENTION (a number
already used by an existing owner, cited), PRIOR (chosen for a stated reason,
never fitted on the board it is applied to) or STRUCTURAL (a definition, not a
tunable). Nothing is fitted. The report publishes a sensitivity for each PRIOR

positions.why: K is reported separately and never enters a cross-position comparison: the served board prices no kicker, so every kicker value is UNPRICED (never zero).

minGames.why: Investigation B's MIN_GAMES (scripts/idp_replacement_research.py). Fewer than this many games is an unestablished role: the player is not a weekly replacement and his ppg is not an expectation.

walkForwardEvalWeeks.why: The first weeks with at least minGames of strictly earlier history. A replacement is chosen from weeks before the week it is scored on (directive section 13 rule 13: no future data in historical predictions).

health.why: Investigation B's strict rule (is_healthy_strict): an NFL team, an EXPLICIT status of Active, and no unavailable injury designation. A missing or unrecognised status is UNKNOWN and excluded, never healthy. Questionable is UNCERTAIN: kept in the pool and counted, with a sensitivity that drops it.

primary.why: Investigation B's A4 bar: P10 of the season-to-date ppg of the players the league's production-optimal lineups start at the position. 'Startable at all'.

rank.why: LI-5's waiver tier averages free-agent ranks 1-3 (DEFAULT_BAND = 2); the 3rd-best is the rank the directive names.

topK.why: The smallest panel whose median survives one outlying player in each direction (the blend's own n>=5 rung, CLAUDE.md step 7). Sensitivities at 3 and 10 are published.

band.why: LI-5 DEFAULT_BAND: the best-ball starter floor averages the lowest `band` team marginals.

rounds.why: Three serial matching rounds: each team makes at most one claim per round; a round's winners leave the pool. 11 of 12 live rosters sit at the 58 cap, so every claim is a swap and deep multi-claim sequences are not realistic in one waiver cycle.

allocation.mechanismNote: A planner allocation (maximises total lineup points gained, each free agent to at most one team). It is NOT a model of FAAB bids and does not predict who wins a contested player.

candidateCapPerPosition.why: Bounds compute only: the top candidates by ppg at each eligible position. A candidate outside the cap would need to beat 25 better-producing players at his own position to matter.

teamSpecific.why: The neutral hypothetical used for the table: the team loses its highest-ppg player at the position. The evaluator accepts any package.

replicates.why: Percentile-interval resolution about 0.002; compute stays below a minute per table.

bootstrap.unit: level definitions: each player's own played weeks are resampled with replacement and the whole definition is recomputed (propagates small-sample ppg noise and winner's-curse selection). Team-level and player-level tables: the cluster (team / player) is resampled, conditional on the realised ppg estimates.
bootstrap.caveat: Six weeks is a small window. Intervals describe sampling noise inside it, not forward regression of a wire player's production.

eligibility.why: Sleeper evaluates slot eligibility against fantasy_positions (a DL/LB hybrid is legal at either slot; Lane A verified the exact solver reproduces Sleeper's best-ball totals 72 of 72 on that basis). The nominal-position mode is Investigation B's pool keying and is the comparison for the eligibility-uncertainty band.

unitsNote: Levels are published in two units that are never mixed: ppg (league-scored points per game played, from the host-native scorer) and board value (rankDerivedValue, 1-9999). A player the board does not price has NO board value (UNPRICED, counted); a player with no games has NO ppg. Neither is ever zero.
